issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. The diff only swaps RandomForestRegressor for XGBRegressor. It reads no files, pastes in no labels and never touches test labels. It still passes the seed through random_state and stays within the 8 threads.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. fit_predict still trains only on train_smiles/train_y and returns one prediction per test molecule.

Minor cleanup: MAX_FEATURES and MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF are no longer used and should be deleted. N_TREES now sets the number of XGBoost boosting rounds (at learning_rate 0.05), not the forest size, so the old name and value may not suit XGBoost.

Recomputed z: the candidate improves on the incumbent by 0.3911 - 0.3901 = 0.0010. With one run on each side and a noise sd of 0.0037, the sd of the difference is 0.0037*sqrt(2) ≈ 0.00523, so z ≈ 0.19. That matches the reported 0.183 once rounding of the values is allowed for. The gain is well within noise, so the provisional reject is consistent with the numbers. The diff makes no claims to check.
